title: Survey Questions - Public Right of Way
description: Use this service request to request survey information on a City of Dallas public right-of-way. **Be advised the City does not do surveys for personal or private property. ** The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 3 business days.

actions.tagline: Submit a 311 request for City public right-of-way survey information.
actions.why: For survey information about a City of Dallas public right-of-way, including a right-of-way survey, subdivision plat, or block map. The 311 request form asks which information is needed, the location address, and the reason when a right-of-way survey is requested.
actions.why_not: The online form for "Survey Questions - Public Right of Way" requests does not apply to a survey of personal or private property; the City says it does not provide those surveys.
actions.how: Go to Dallas 311 > Choose "Streets, Medians, Sidewalks and Alleys" > Choose "Survey Questions - Public Right of Way"
actions.how_formatted: [Go to Dallas 311](https://dallascrm.my.site.com/public/s/) > Choose "Streets, Medians, Sidewalks and Alleys" > Choose "Survey Questions - Public Right of Way"
